loop.top3_why: Candidate A uses a weighted combination derived from a pooled meta‑model trained on other series, which provides a more robust weighting scheme than a simple mean. Its per‑window errors are consistently low and stable across the three validation windows, avoiding the large drop seen in candidate C. loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B, while very close in score, shows a higher error in the second window and relies on an unweighted mean that may over‑emphasise models with correlated errors. Candidate C achieves very low error in the first two windows but suffers a dramatic increase in the third, indicating over‑fitting to the early windows and likely poor performance on the test horizon.
